stock.description: DaChan Food (Asia) Limited, operating alongside its various subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in the production and distribution of animal feeds, chilled and frozen poultry products, and a diverse range of processed food items. The company's operations are structured across three main divisions: Processed Food, Livestock Feeds, and Chicken Meat. Within its Processed Food division, the company manufactures and supplies a variety of prepared food products, including pickled, pre-fried, and convenient instant meals. The Livestock Feeds segment focuses on creating and disseminating a wide array of nutritional products, such as complete feeds, base mixes, and premixes, designed for different types of farm animals including pigs, laying hens, broilers, ducks, and breeder poultry. These are marketed under established brands like Dr. Nupak, DaChan, and Green Knight. Its Chicken Meat segment encompasses the entire vertical integration of poultry production, from broiler farming and the hatching of breeder eggs to managing contract farming operations. This division also handles the processing and commercialization of both chilled and frozen chicken products, sold under the DaChan and Sisters' Kitchen labels. Beyond these core activities, the firm participates in animal husbandry, including the construction and rental of poultry facilities, as well as the breeding and sale of swine. Furthermore, it engages in the production and commerce of feed meals, associated additives, aquaculture products, and specialized veterinary and aquatic pharmaceuticals. DaChan Food (Asia) reaches its diverse customer base through multiple channels, including major retail chains, local farmers' markets, e-commerce platforms, independent distributors, and supermarkets. Its geographical footprint extends across the People's Republic of China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Japan, and other parts of the broader Asia Pacific region. Established in 2007, the company maintains its primary office in Beijing, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Great Wall International (Holdings) Ltd.
